courseSource: Lincoln, Complete Works II pp.9-10: March 9 recounts the March 5 transmission for consideration and same-day endorsed opinion; Holt/Scott to Lincoln, March 5, LoC mal0779200, document pp.1-6 (Knox transcript). [I] Paraphrased question, not a recovered March 5 original. The source quantities and conclusions are not seeded as received inputs. [I] Supplying and reinforcing the existing federal garrison serves the maintenance purpose in Lincoln, Complete Works II pp.9-10. Scott's forecasts in OR I-I pp.197-198 are attributed assessments. Bare withdrawal carries no attributed motive. Scott's undated proposal expressly seeks reconciliation and continued or restored Union adherence (OR I-I pp.200-201). His prediction of success and forecast that relief is unavailing add no terms. The withdrawal of Sumter and Pickens conflicts with Lincoln's prior maintenance instruction (Complete Works II p.9). Scott expressly retains Jefferson and Taylor. That limit supplies no separate term for the represented act at the two forts.
